subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **At**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Dusk: **the time in the evening when the sun has already gone down and it is nearly dark.
 
• The preposition **'at'** is used with specific times of the day such as at night, at sunrise, at dawn and at dusk.
 
• The use of the preposition '**at' **is appropriate with '**dusk'**.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 3 is **Option 1**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **'From'** is used to indicate that something **originates** or comes from something else or

 some person.
 
• **On** is used to refer to a **position** on a surface.
 
• **Since** is used as a preposition, a conjunction and an adverb to refer to a time, and as a conjunction to introduce a reason. 

 

**Correct Passage:__ ***His friend did not return even the next day, or the day after. For several days, the partridge (1) __kept__ worrying, and then gave up (2) __hope__ of his friend's return. **(3)** __** At**__ dusk, a hare came to the tree and (4)_________ an empty hole at the foot of the tree, (5)_________ shelter inside. Since the partridge had given up hope, he did not object to the hole being occupied by the hare.*
